user.title: Create entity proxy
user.description: Choose an existing entity to wrap. You can hide the original in your dashboard, but do not disable it.

rules.title: Configure rules
rules.description: Enter JSON arrays/objects. Leave [] and {} for transparent pass-through. State rules override attributes; action rules replace selected service actions. See the README for examples and security constraints.

error.invalid_rules: Invalid or unsafe JSON rules. Review the logs and README.
error.proxy_source: A proxy cannot wrap another Entity Proxy entity.

init.title: Edit proxy rules
init.description: Rules are updated when you save. See the README for JSON examples.

error.invalid_rules: Invalid or unsafe rules. Review the logs and README.
